# cubeproof command line reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m cubeproof.cli.reference` from `cubeproof/cli/spec.py`; do not edit. -->

Every command is `cubeproof COMMAND ...` (or `python -m cubeproof COMMAND ...`). A usage error, an unknown option or an invalid combination of options exits with 3 before any work. Result documents are written to standard output; notes, errors (`cubeproof: error [rule] detail`) and the run log are written to standard error. `cubeproof --version` prints `cubeproof VERSION` and exits with 0; `-h` after the program or any command prints its help.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | success: run: all still-owned requested regions closed, no model, anomaly or block; certify: PROVED; audit: all selected strict matches; other commands: completed |
| 1 | open work, resource block or time allocation ended; certify OPEN; audit incomplete, not comparable or reproved only; a pending handoff after its wait |
| 2 | a valid model was found; certify MODEL_FOUND |
| 3 | usage, configuration or lock conflict (including a request the inputs cannot satisfy) |
| 4 | integrity failure, inconsistency or strict audit mismatch |
| 5 | missing or failing tool, retry exhaustion or I/O service failure |
| 6 | the run recorded an anomaly (without a higher-priority condition) |
| 130 | explicit user signal interruption, after clean handling |

For completed work the conditions have the priority 4 > 5 > 2 > 6 > 1 > 0; an interruption exits with 130 unless an integrity error had already been diagnosed (4). Preflight errors return before any work.

## `cubeproof bundle import`

Normalize external DIMACS into an immutable bundle.

```text
cubeproof bundle import INPUT.cnf -o PATH
```

| Argument | Value | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` | `INPUT.cnf` | yes |  | the external DIMACS file |
| `-o`, `--output` | `PATH` | yes |  | the new bundle directory (must not exist) |

Standard output: the bundle document (path, formula_sha256, variables, clauses, source_sha256) as JSON.

| Exit | Meaning here |
|---|---|
| 0 | the bundle was published |
| 3 | usage, unreadable input or existing target |

## `cubeproof campaign create`

Create a campaign file from bundles, a policy and admission lists.

```text
cubeproof campaign create --bundle PATH [--bundle PATH]... --policy PATH --admit PATH --solver TEXT --solver-argv JSON --checker TEXT [--roots PATH] [--root-split SPEC] [--author TEXT] -o PATH
```

| Argument | Value | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--bundle` | `PATH` | yes |  | a bundle directory below the campaign directory (repeatable) |
| `--policy` | `PATH` | yes |  | the policy file (a complete policy object) |
| `--admit` | `PATH` | yes |  | the admission file {checker_sha256, solvers} |
| `--solver` | `TEXT` | yes |  | the local path of the pinned solver |
| `--solver-argv` | `JSON` | yes |  | JSON list of the solver's options (no executable, no paths) |
| `--checker` | `TEXT` | yes |  | the local path of the pinned checker |
| `--roots` | `PATH` | no |  | a cubeproof-roots-1 file (default: the empty cube per formula) |
| `--root-split` | `SPEC` | no | `none` | none, static:FILE (a cubeproof-prefixes-1 file) or proof-prefix-v1:K |
| `--author` | `TEXT` | no | `cubeproof` | the author recorded in the campaign |
| `-o`, `--output` | `PATH` | yes |  | the campaign file (must not exist) |

Standard output: one line: the campaign ID and the file.

Rules:

- the campaign file is published beside its bundles (their paths stay inside its directory).
- the tools' hashes are measured from the given local paths and recorded.

| Exit | Meaning here |
|---|---|
| 0 | the campaign was published |
| 3 | usage or invalid input |
| 5 | a tool is unusable |

## `cubeproof shard`

Plan shards of the work for independent machines.

```text
cubeproof shard [--campaign PATH] [--evidence MANIFEST] --machines N [--formula KEY]... [--weights PATH] [--from-open CERT] [--journals PATH ...] [--scope campaign|formulas] -o PATH
```

| Argument | Value | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--campaign` | `PATH` | no |  | the campaign file |
| `--evidence` | `MANIFEST` | no |  | an evidence manifest (portable directory): the exclusive alternative to the campaign/journal path arguments |
| `--machines` | `N` | yes |  | number of machines |
| `--formula` | `KEY` | no |  | plan only the nodes of this formula of the campaign (default: all formulas) (repeatable) |
| `--weights` | `PATH` | no |  | a cubeproof-weights-1 file (cost per planned node ID) |
| `--from-open` | `CERT` | no |  | plan the open frontier of this certificate (recomputed from the journals) |
| `--journals` | `PATH` | no |  | journal files to use (explicit; no search) |
| `--scope` | `campaign/formulas` | no |  | the frontier to plan: campaign (certificate.open) or formulas (formula_open) |
| `-o`, `--output` | `PATH` | yes |  | the output directory for the `shard-K.json` files |

Standard output: the plan (shards, node counts, costs, hashes, empty machines, the formulas of --formula) as JSON.

Rules:

- exactly one of --campaign and --evidence.
- --from-open needs --journals and --campaign; --journals and --scope belong to a frontier plan.
- --evidence plans the frontier of the manifest's certificate, recomputed from its journals.
- a frontier containing a model node is refused, and so is a certificate that does not match its journals.

| Exit | Meaning here |
|---|---|
| 0 | the shards were written |
| 3 | usage or invalid input |
| 4 | integrity failure |

## `cubeproof run`

Run one worker.

```text
cubeproof run [--campaign PATH] [--evidence MANIFEST] --results PATH --work PATH --worker TEXT --solver TEXT --checker TEXT [--helper TEXT] [--shard PATH] [--jobs N] [--memory SIZE] [--disk SIZE] [--max-hours H] [--policy-override KEY=JSON_VALUE]... [--proof-mode transient|retain|stream] [--inbox PATH] [--outbox PATH] [--export PATH] [--reopen-blocked] [--campaign-policy] [--accept-code-change] [--no-cache] [--no-known-answer] [--verbose] [--quiet]
```

| Argument | Value | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--campaign` | `PATH` | no |  | the campaign file |
| `--evidence` | `MANIFEST` | no |  | an evidence manifest (portable directory): the exclusive alternative to the campaign/journal path arguments |
| `--results` | `PATH` | yes |  | the worker's results directory |
| `--work` | `PATH` | yes |  | the worker's disposable work directory |
| `--worker` | `TEXT` | yes |  | the worker name (a-z, 0-9, _ and -) |
| `--solver` | `TEXT` | yes |  | the local path of the pinned solver |
| `--checker` | `TEXT` | yes |  | the local path of the pinned checker |
| `--helper` | `TEXT` | no |  | the local path of the splitter helper (optional) |
| `--shard` | `PATH` | no |  | a cubeproof-shard-1 file to own (first use or later) |
| `--jobs` | `N` | no |  | CPU slots |
| `--memory` | `SIZE` | no |  | memory budget (512, 64MiB, 2G) |
| `--disk` | `SIZE` | no |  | disk budget (512, 64MiB, 2G) |
| `--max-hours` | `H` | no |  | time allocation in hours |
| `--policy-override` | `KEY=JSON_VALUE` | no |  | override a policy field for this run (repeatable) |
| `--proof-mode` | `transient/retain/stream` | no |  | how proofs are kept |
| `--inbox` | `PATH` | no |  | the directory this worker accepts shards from |
| `--outbox` | `PATH` | no |  | the directory this worker publishes handoffs into |
| `--export` | `PATH` | no |  | the directory of the periodic journal export |
| `--reopen-blocked` |  | no |  | commit a node_reopen for every blocked node first |
| `--campaign-policy` |  | no |  | return to the campaign's policy for the fields the session before had changed and this command line does not name |
| `--accept-code-change` |  | no |  | continue a journal whose session before ran other cubeproof sources |
| `--no-cache` |  | no |  | ignore and rewrite the derived state cache |
| `--no-known-answer` |  | no |  | skip the known-answer control of the checker (only for scripted test tools) |
| `-v`, `--verbose` |  | no |  | also log debug events |
| `-q`, `--quiet` |  | no |  | log warnings and errors only |

Standard output: the run result (exit_code, reason, open work by state, session counters, given_away, notes) as one JSON line; the log (progress each minute) and notes go to standard error.

Rules:

- exactly one of --campaign and --evidence.
- -v and -q exclude each other.
- the first use without --shard owns all requested roots (expanded by root splits); a later run never reconstructs ownership from a changed command line.
- the result never claims that handed-off regions are closed (given_away is separate).
- status.json and status.txt are published into the results directory.

| Exit | Meaning here |
|---|---|
| 0 | all still-owned requested regions closed |
| 1 | open work, a resource block or the time allocation ended |
| 2 | a valid model was found |
| 3 | usage, configuration or a lock conflict |
| 4 | integrity failure |
| 5 | a tool or the I/O service failed, or retries were exhausted |
| 6 | an anomaly was recorded |
| 130 | interrupted by SIGINT/SIGTERM after clean handling |

## `cubeproof handoff`

Ask a worker to give nodes away, and follow the answer.

```text
cubeproof handoff --results PATH --nodes N --output-name TEXT [--wait-ms N]
```

| Argument | Value | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--results` | `PATH` | yes |  | the results directory of the giving worker |
| `--nodes` | `N` | yes |  | number of nodes to give |
| `--output-name` | `TEXT` | yes |  | the name of the output file in the worker's outbox |
| `--wait-ms` | `N` | no | `0` | wait this long for the completion (0: do not wait) |

Standard output: the outcome (state, request, response, output) as JSON.

| Exit | Meaning here |
|---|---|
| 0 | completed, or the request is durable and no wait was asked |
| 1 | pending, publishing or blocked after the wait |
| 3 | usage, no inbox, a taken output name or a rejected request |

## `cubeproof status`

Show the monitor a worker publishes.

```text
cubeproof status --results PATH [--json]
```

| Argument | Value | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--results` | `PATH` | yes |  | the worker's results directory |
| `--json` |  | no |  | print the validated status document as JSON |

Standard output: the human rendering of status.json (a stale status is marked), or with --json the document.

Rules:

- status is a derived monitor, never evidence.

| Exit | Meaning here |
|---|---|
| 0 | the status was read and is valid |
| 3 | no status or an invalid status |

## `cubeproof certify`

Certify journals against a campaign.

```text
cubeproof certify [--campaign PATH] [--journals PATH ...] [--evidence MANIFEST] [-o PATH]
```

| Argument | Value | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--campaign` | `PATH` | no |  | the campaign file |
| `--journals` | `PATH` | no |  | journal files to use (explicit; no search) |
| `--evidence` | `MANIFEST` | no |  | an evidence manifest (portable directory): the exclusive alternative to the campaign/journal path arguments |
| `-o`, `--output` | `PATH` | no |  | write the certificate here (must not exist) |

Standard output: the verdict and the certificate file.

Rules:

- --campaign with --journals, or --evidence alone.
- --evidence recomputes the certificate and requires it to equal the packaged one.

| Exit | Meaning here |
|---|---|
| 0 | PROVED |
| 1 | OPEN |
| 2 | MODEL_FOUND |
| 3 | usage or an unreadable campaign |
| 4 | integrity failure or INCONSISTENT |

## `cubeproof evidence package`

Publish a portable evidence directory.

```text
cubeproof evidence package --campaign PATH --journals PATH ... -o PATH
```

| Argument | Value | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--campaign` | `PATH` | yes |  | the campaign file |
| `--journals` | `PATH` | yes |  | journal files to certify and snapshot |
| `-o`, `--output` | `PATH` | yes |  | the evidence directory (must not exist) |

Standard output: the package (manifest and certificate hashes, verdict, counts) as JSON.

Rules:

- the campaign, bundle files and certified journal prefixes are copied before the certificate, which is recomputed from the copies, and the manifest comes last.
- exit 0 whatever the verdict: certify maps the verdict.

| Exit | Meaning here |
|---|---|
| 0 | the package was published |
| 3 | usage or invalid input |
| 4 | integrity failure |

## `cubeproof journal verify`

Validate every complete record of a journal.

```text
cubeproof journal verify JOURNAL --campaign PATH
```

| Argument | Value | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `journal` | `JOURNAL` | yes |  | the journal file |
| `--campaign` | `PATH` | yes |  | the campaign the journal belongs to |

Standard output: the journal's identity, extent and torn tail as JSON.

| Exit | Meaning here |
|---|---|
| 0 | the journal validates (a torn tail is reported) |
| 3 | usage or an unreadable campaign |
| 4 | integrity failure, or a journal that cannot be read |

## `cubeproof journal repair`

Remove a torn tail of a journal.

```text
cubeproof journal repair JOURNAL --campaign PATH
```

| Argument | Value | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `journal` | `JOURNAL` | yes |  | the journal file |
| `--campaign` | `PATH` | yes |  | the campaign the journal belongs to |

Standard output: what was removed, and the journal verified again, as JSON.

Rules:

- takes the containing results directory's run.lock without waiting.

| Exit | Meaning here |
|---|---|
| 0 | repaired, or nothing to repair |
| 3 | usage, or the results directory is locked by a live worker |
| 4 | any damage other than a torn tail: the file is left unchanged |

## `cubeproof audit`

Recompute audit of certified leaves: strict reproduction or independent reproof.

```text
cubeproof audit [--campaign PATH] [--certificate CERT] [--journals PATH ...] [--evidence MANIFEST] [--sample N] [--all] [--seed HEX64] [--comparison strict|reprove] --results PATH --work PATH --worker TEXT --solver TEXT --checker TEXT [--helper TEXT] [--memory SIZE] [--disk SIZE] [--proof-cap SIZE] [--no-known-answer]
```

| Argument | Value | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--campaign` | `PATH` | no |  | the campaign file |
| `--certificate` | `CERT` | no |  | the certificate to audit (bound to its exact journal prefixes and recomputed) |
| `--journals` | `PATH` | no |  | journal files to use (explicit; no search) |
| `--evidence` | `MANIFEST` | no |  | an evidence manifest (portable directory): the exclusive alternative to the campaign/journal path arguments |
| `--sample` | `N` | no |  | audit the N smallest by seeded hash (N > 0) |
| `--all` |  | no |  | audit every used attempt |
| `--seed` | `HEX64` | no |  | sampling seed, 64 hex digits (default: SHA-256 of the certificate) |
| `--comparison` | `strict/reprove` | no | `strict` | strict (historical proof hash) or reprove (a new proof, a different guarantee) |
| `--results` | `PATH` | yes |  | the audit's own results directory (journal, report) |
| `--work` | `PATH` | yes |  | the audit's disposable work directory |
| `--worker` | `TEXT` | yes |  | the audit's worker name (a-z, 0-9, _ and -) |
| `--solver` | `TEXT` | yes |  | the local path of the pinned solver |
| `--checker` | `TEXT` | yes |  | the local path of the pinned checker |
| `--helper` | `TEXT` | no |  | the local path of the splitter helper (recorded only: an audit never splits) |
| `--memory` | `SIZE` | no |  | memory budget (512, 64MiB, 2G) |
| `--disk` | `SIZE` | no |  | disk budget (512, 64MiB, 2G) |
| `--proof-cap` | `SIZE` | no |  | proof cap (default: the larger of the policy cap and the largest selected reference proof), clamped to the budgets |
| `--no-known-answer` |  | no |  | skip the known-answer control of the checker (only for scripted test tools) |

Standard output: the outcome (exit_code, reason, journal position, pending targets, the report file and its summary: comparison, population, selected, seed, counts) as one JSON line; the report cubeproof-audit-report-1 is <results>/audit-report.json.

Rules:

- --sample N or --all, not both.
- --evidence alone, or --campaign with --certificate and --journals.
- the certificate is recomputed from snapshots of its exact journal prefixes before any target is chosen; records appended later are not used.
- the solver runs without a time limit; --memory, --disk and --proof-cap bound it.
- a strict audit runs only the source solver: a target without it is NOT_COMPARABLE.
- a restart continues the plan in the same results directory; another selection there is refused.

| Exit | Meaning here |
|---|---|
| 0 | every selected target of a strict audit matched its historical proof hash |
| 1 | open, not comparable or reproved only, pending targets, an empty population, or a reprove comparison |
| 3 | usage, configuration or a lock conflict |
| 4 | integrity failure: the certificate or plan disagrees with the evidence, a mismatch, a model of a used target or a rejected new proof |
| 5 | a missing or failing tool, or the I/O service failed |
| 130 | interrupted by SIGINT/SIGTERM after clean handling |

## `cubeproof verify-retained`

Re-check every committed retained proof with the admitted checker, without a solver.

```text
cubeproof verify-retained [--campaign PATH] [--journals PATH ...] [--evidence MANIFEST] --proofs-root PATH --results PATH --work PATH --worker TEXT --checker TEXT [--memory SIZE]
```

| Argument | Value | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--campaign` | `PATH` | no |  | the campaign file |
| `--journals` | `PATH` | no |  | journal files to use (explicit; no search) |
| `--evidence` | `MANIFEST` | no |  | an evidence manifest (portable directory): the exclusive alternative to the campaign/journal path arguments |
| `--proofs-root` | `PATH` | yes |  | the results directory holding proofs/ |
| `--results` | `PATH` | yes |  | the verification's own results directory |
| `--work` | `PATH` | yes |  | the directory of the private proof copies |
| `--worker` | `TEXT` | yes |  | the verification's worker name |
| `--checker` | `TEXT` | yes |  | the local path of the admitted checker |
| `--memory` | `SIZE` | no |  | memory cap of each check (512, 64MiB, 2G) |

Standard output: the counts (expected, found, verified, missing, corrupt, rejected, exhausted, failed, unretained) and the report file as one JSON line; the report is <results>/verify-retained.json.

Rules:

- --evidence alone, or --campaign with --journals.
- every committed retained reference of the journals is expected; none is skipped.
- the evidence is only read; the results and work directories are separate from it.

| Exit | Meaning here |
|---|---|
| 0 | every expected retained proof was verified (and at least one was expected) |
| 1 | a check was exhausted, or nothing was expected |
| 3 | usage, configuration or a lock conflict |
| 4 | a proof is missing, corrupt or rejected, or an input fails integrity |
| 5 | the checker is missing, unusable, not admitted or failed |
